evals.name: named-customer-with-mcp-detected
evals.prompt: /slackbot Providence Health (assume Slack MCP is configured and the user belongs to 2 channels that mention Providence)
evals.expected_output: Skill calls MCP conversations.list (is_member=true), searches the 2 matching channels for 'Providence', assembles the raw profile at .org-profile-raw/providence-health/slack.md, runs anonymize.py scrub with --scrub 'Providence Health' and the detected person names, produces .org-profile-raw/providence-health/slack.anonymized.md, presents the approval summary with placeholders, asks the user to approve/edit/reject.

assertions.rationale: Raw (un-anonymized) profile must persist locally so the user can audit the source.
Only the anonymized version is allowed to flow onward to /focus-group.
Customer name must be replaced with a placeholder in the anonymized profile.

evals.name: no-slack-mcp-routes-to-install-offer
evals.prompt: /slackbot Acme Credit Union (assume no Slack MCP server configured in the user's MCP config)
evals.expected_output: Skill stops; presents the four-option install menu from /focus-group references/usage.md §8 (walk through Slack MCP setup / skip for this run / etc.). Does not attempt to query anything. Records the answer in .install-asked.json.

assertions.rationale: No query should run when the MCP is missing — no raw profile should be created.
Install offer answer must persist so it doesn't repeat on every run.

evals.name: no-mentions-found
evals.prompt: /slackbot Obscure Customer (MCP is configured but no channels the user belongs to mention this customer)
evals.expected_output: Skill reports plainly: 'no mentions of Obscure Customer in any channel you're a member of in the last 30 days.' Offers to widen the window to 90 or 180 days, or skip. Does not invent mentions.

assertions.rationale: Must offer to widen the window rather than fail silently.
Empty result must NOT produce an anonymized profile — no fabrication.

evals.name: anonymize-failure-blocks-output
evals.prompt: /slackbot Providence Health (MCP works, but anonymize.py script is missing)
evals.expected_output: Raw profile saved to .org-profile-raw/.../slack.md (local-only, as designed). Anonymize call fails. Skill refuses to hand the profile onward to /focus-group and tells the user the anonymize layer is required for any model-bound use. Suggests installing the /anonymize skill folder.

assertions.rationale: Raw profile is local-only and may persist even when anonymize fails.
No anonymized profile may be produced when scrub failed — load-bearing for privacy.

evals.name: help-mode-no-query
evals.expected_output: Prints SKILL.md walkthrough (what it is, when to invoke, prerequisites, the 5-step workflow, privacy posture, install path). Does NOT query Slack. Does NOT prompt for a customer name.

assertions.rationale: Help mode must not call any Slack MCP tools.

evals.name: scope-respects-member-only
evals.prompt: /slackbot CustomerX (MCP is configured; the user is NOT a member of #customerx-deal-room but the channel exists)
evals.expected_output: Skill does NOT surface anything from #customerx-deal-room. The query is constrained to is_member=true. The summary may note 'A channel named #customerx-deal-room exists but you are not a member of it.' (informational only, no contents disclosed).

assertions.rationale: Member-only scope is load-bearing — no message content from non-member channels may appear.
The MCP query parameters must include is_member=true.
